title: Review digest team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/review-digest.yaml: the team layer of the review-digest cascade concern that /review:explain-change reads. Prose and the trigger table: docs/conventions/review-digest.md. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

digest_policy.description: When the skill builds or offers a digest. off: never unasked. offer: offer it when a trigger fires. always: build it when the pull request is marked ready, else behave as offer.

max_files.description: The files trigger fires when the pull request changes more than this many files.

max_changed_lines.description: The changed-lines trigger fires when additions plus deletions exceed this.

blast_radius.description: The blast-radius trigger fires when the assessed blast radius is one of these levels. A list replaces the layer below whole.

risk_paths.description: The risk-path trigger fires when a changed path matches one of these globs: ** spans directories, * and ? stay inside one path segment. At most 64 globs of at most 256 characters; a longer list or glob makes the layer's risk_paths invalid. A list replaces the layer below whole.

opt_in_label.description: The label trigger fires when the pull request carries this label. An empty string turns the label trigger off.
